key_points: Third round of 2026 layoffs (~300 HR/tech roles) signals ongoing cost discipline under CEO D'Amaro but not thesis-changing
BofA and Kalkine highlight strength in theme parks, cruise fleet expansion, and streaming price hikes supporting near-term fundamentals

Insider/billionaire selling and Netflix headlines are noise for long-term Disney thesis
